spots.name: Zytglogge
spots.summary: The Zytglogge is a landmark medieval tower in Bern, Switzerland. Built in the early 13th century, it has served the city as a guard tower, prison, clock tower, centre of urban life and civic memorial.

spots.name: Bern Minster

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Bern Minster is a Swiss Reformed cathedral in the old city of Bern, Switzerland. Built in the Gothic style, its construction started in 1421. Its tower, with a height of 100.6 m (330 ft), was only completed in 1893. It is the tallest cathedral in Switzerland and is a Cultural Property of National Significance.

spots.name: Federal Palace of Switzerland
spots.summary: The Federal Palace is a building in Bern housing the Swiss Federal Assembly (legislature) and the Federal Council (executive). It is the seat of the government of Switzerland and parliament of the country. The building is a listed symmetrical complex just over 300 metres (980 ft) long.

spots.name: Kindlifresserbrunnen
spots.summary: The Kindlifresserbrunnen is a painted stone fountain at the Kornhausplatz in Bern, Switzerland. It is one of the Old City of Bern's fountains from the 16th century.

photo.author: Andrew Bossi; sculpture by Hans Gieng (de)

spots.name: Old City
spots.summary: The Old City is the medieval city center of Bern, Switzerland. Built on a narrow hill bordered on three sides by the river Aare, its compact layout has remained essentially unchanged since its construction during the twelfth to the fifteenth century.

spots.name: Einsteinhaus

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: The Einsteinhaus is a museum and a former residence of Albert Einstein. It is located on Kramgasse No. 49 in Bern, Switzerland. A flat on the second floor of the house was occupied by Einstein, his wife Mileva Marić, and their son Hans Einstein from 1903 to 1905.

names.ja: アインシュタイン・ハウス

spots.name: Bern Historical Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Bern Historical Museum is the second largest historical museum in Switzerland. It was designed by the Neuchâtel architect André Lambert and built in 1894. Since it was initially conceived as the Swiss National Museum, the architect took as his model various historic castles from the 15th and 16th centuries.

spots.name: Käfigturm
spots.summary: The Käfigturm is a Baroque tower in Bern, Switzerland. It is part of the UNESCO Cultural World Heritage Site of the Old City of Bern and the tower is a Cultural Property of National Significance. The original tower was built as a gate house during the second expansion of Bern in 1256.

spots.name: Swiss National Library

hours.note: Closed Sat, Sun

spots.summary: The Swiss National Library is the national library of Switzerland.

spots.name: Bundesplatz
spots.summary: The Bundesplatz is the Government Plaza in Bern, the de facto capital city of Switzerland. It is situated in the Old City of Bern, the medieval city center of Bern. It is part of the Innere Neustadt which was built during the second expansion in 1255 to 1260, though the plaza was not built until much later.

spots.name: Gerechtigkeitsbrunnen
spots.summary: The Gerechtigkeitsbrunnen is a 16th-century fountain in the Gerechtigkeitsgasse in the Old City of Bern, Switzerland. It is the only Bernese fountain to retain all original design elements, and is listed as a cultural heritage of national significance.

spots.name: Bärengraben
spots.summary: The Bärengraben, or Bear Pit, is a tourist attraction in the Swiss capital city of Bern. It is a bear pit, or enclosure housing bears, situated at the eastern edge of the old city of Bern, next to the Nydeggbrücke and the River Aar.

spots.name: Kunstmuseum Bern

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Museum of Fine Arts Bern, established in 1879 in Bern, is the museum of fine arts of the de facto capital of Switzerland.

names.es: Museo de Bellas Artes de Berna

spots.name: Gurten
spots.summary: The Gurten is a mountain situated just to the south of Bern, the capital city of Switzerland. It is 858 metres (2,815 ft) high, and the summit yields views of Bern, of the Jura mountains and of the Alps.

spots.name: Zähringerbrunnen
spots.summary: The Zähringerbrunnen is a fountain on Kramgasse in the Old City of Bern, Switzerland. It is a Swiss Cultural Property of National Significance and is part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Old City of Bern.

spots.name: Nydeggbrücke
spots.summary: The Nydeggbrücke is a bridge in Bern, Switzerland, which connects the eastern part of the old city to the new part. It crosses over the Aare and is located very close to the Bärengraben. It was built in parallel to the Untertorbrücke in 1840, which until then had been the only bridge crossing the Aare.

spots.name: Mosesbrunnen
spots.summary: The Mosesbrunnen is a fountain on Münsterplatz in the Old City of Bern, Switzerland. It is a Swiss Cultural Property of National Significance and is part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Old City of Bern.

spots.name: Untertorbrücke
spots.summary: The Untertorbrücke is a stone arch bridge that spans the Aare at the easternmost point of the Enge peninsula in the city of Bern, Switzerland, connecting the Mattequartier in the Old City to the Schosshalde neighbourhood.

spots.name: Swiss Literary Archives

hours.note: Closed Sat, Sun

spots.summary: The Swiss Literary Archives in Bern collects literary estates in all four national languages of Switzerland. It is part of the Swiss National Library operated by the Federal Office of Culture within the Federal Department of Home Affairs.

spots.name: Kramgasse
spots.summary: The Kramgasse is one of the principal streets in the Old City of Bern, the medieval city centre of Bern, Switzerland. It was the center of urban life in Bern until the 19th century. Today, it is a popular shopping street.

spots.name: Swiss Federal Archives

hours.note: Closed Mon, Fri, Sat, Sun

spots.summary: The Swiss Federal Archives are the national archives of Switzerland. Additionally, the cantons have official archives of their own. The building and its collections are a Swiss heritage site of national significance.

spots.name: Church of St. Peter and Paul, Bern

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Church of St. Peter and Paul is a Christian Catholic church in Bern, Switzerland. It is designated as a Cultural Property of National Significance

names.it: Cattedrale dei Santi Pietro e Paolo

spots.name: Anna-Seiler-Brunnen
spots.summary: The Anna-Seiler-Brunnen is a fountain on Marktgasse in the Old City of Bern, Switzerland. It is a Swiss Cultural Property of National Significance and is part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Old City of Bern.

spots.name: Church of the Holy Ghost, Bern

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Church of the Holy Ghost is a Swiss Reformed Church in Bern, Switzerland. The Swiss heritage site of national significance building is located at Spitalgasse 44 in the Old City of Bern. It is one of largest Swiss Reformed churches in Switzerland.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Church of the Holy Ghost, Bern

spots.name: Simsonbrunnen
spots.summary: The Simsonbrunnen or Samson fountain is a fountain on the Kramgasse in the Old City of Bern, Switzerland. It is a Swiss Cultural Property of National Significance and is part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Old City of Bern.

spots.name: Kunsthalle Bern

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Kunsthalle Bern is a Kunsthalle on the Helvetiaplatz in Bern, Switzerland.

spots.name: Natural History Museum of Bern
spots.summary: The Natural History Museum of Bern is a museum in Bern, Switzerland. In its teaching and research it cooperates closely with the University of Bern. It is visited by around 131,000 people yearly.

spots.name: Münsterplatz
spots.summary: The Münsterplatz is a plaza in the Old City of Bern, the medieval city center of Bern, Switzerland. It is part of the Zähringerstadt which was built during the foundation of the old city in 1191.

spots.name: Bärenplatz
spots.summary: The Bärenplatz is a plaza in the Old City of Bern, the medieval city center of Bern, Switzerland. It is part of the Innere Neustadt which was built during the second expansion from 1255 to 1260. It is located north of Bundesplatz, west of Käfigturm and south of Waisenhausplatz.

spots.name: Bern Theatre

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: Bern Theatre, known in the city as Stadttheater Bern, is an opera house and theatre in Bern, Switzerland. The theatre works in four areas: Bern Symphony Orchestra, Musiktheater (opera), Schauspiel (theatre) and Tanz (dance).

names.es: Teatro de la Ópera de Berna

spots.name: Bantiger
spots.summary: The Bantiger is a mountain north of the Emmental Alps, overlooking the region of Bern. It is located east of Ittigen and north of Stettlen, in the canton of Bern.

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Béatrice-von-Wattenwyl-Haus is a town mansion on the Junkerngasse No. 59 in the Old City of Bern, only a few steps away from the Erlacherhof.

spots.name: Nydeggkirche

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Reformed Nydeggkirche is located on the eastern edge of the Old City of Bern, in the Nydegg section.

spots.name: Marktgasse
spots.summary: The Marktgasse is one of the streets in the Old City of Bern, the medieval city center of Bern, Switzerland. It is part of the Innere Neustadt which was built during the 13th Century.

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.name: Hotel Bellevue Palace
spots.summary: The Bellevue Palace is a five-star luxury hotel located in the Old City of Bern, Switzerland. Owned by the Swiss Confederation, it is the state's guesthouse for visiting heads of state and government, and is host to dozens of members of parliament during the weeks the assembly is in session.

spots.name: Kornhausplatz
spots.summary: The Kornhausplatz is a plaza in the Old City of Bern, the medieval city center of Bern, Switzerland. It is on the edge of the Zähringerstadt which was built during the founding of the city in 1191, though the plaza wasn't built until later. It is located near the Kornhausbrücke and the Zytglogge clock tower.

spots.name: Erlacherhof

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Erlacherhof is a town mansion on the Junkerngasse No. 47 in the Old City of Bern, Switzerland.

spots.name: Museum of Communication

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Museum of Communication is an interactive museum dedicated to the subject of communication in Bern, Switzerland. In 2019 it was awarded the Council of Europe Museum Prize. It was founded in 1907 as the corporate museum of Swiss Post, the national postal service of Switzerland.

spots.name: Bern Town Hall
spots.summary: The Bern Town Hall is the building in Bern, Switzerland that houses the Grand Council of Bern, the Executive Council of Bern and the Grand Council of the City of Bern. The building is part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Old City of Berne and is a Swiss heritage site of national significance.

spots.name: Burgerbibliothek of Berne

hours.note: Closed Mon, Sat, Sun

spots.summary: The Burgerbibliothek of Berne is a public library located at Münstergasse 63 in Bern, Switzerland.

names.fr: Bibliothèque de la Bourgeoisie de Berne
names.es: Biblioteca de la Burguesía de Berna

spots.name: Vennerbrunnen
spots.summary: The Vennerbrunnen is a fountain on Rathausplatz in the Old City of Bern, Switzerland. It is a Swiss Cultural Property of National Significance and is part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Old City of Bern.

spots.name: Rose Garden Bern
spots.summary: Little park with a splendid view over the old town. Situated close to the bear pits (follow the path that goes up the hill opposite the bear-pit-roundabout. Quite popular (and populated) during lunchtime. The Rosengarten can be easily reached by bus number 12 from the railway station in Bern in the direction Zentrum Paul Klee.

spots.name: ALPS

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Swiss Alpine Museum is a museum focusing on the relationship between mountains and people, culture, and nature in the Swiss Alps. It is located at Helvetiaplatz 4 in Bern.

spots.name: Pfeiferbrunnen
spots.summary: The Pfeiferbrunnen is a fountain near Spitalgasse 21 in Bern, Switzerland. It is one of the Old City of Bern's 16th-century fountains and is part of the list of Swiss heritage sites of national significance.

spots.name: Herrengasse
spots.summary: The Herrengasse is one of the streets in the Old City of Bern, the medieval city center of Bern, Switzerland. It was the southernmost street of the old Zähringerstadt of Bern and ended at the first city wall.

spots.name: Waisenhausplatz
spots.summary: The Waisenhausplatz is a plaza in the Old City of Bern, the medieval city center of Bern, Switzerland. It is on the edge of the Innere Neustadt which was built during the second expansion from 1255 to 1260, though the plaza was not built until later.

hours.note: Closed Sat, Sun

spots.name: Lorraine railway viaduct
spots.summary: The Lorraine railway viaduct, or Lorraineviadukt, is a railway viaduct in the Swiss city of Bern. It carries the Olten–Bern railway across the River Aare immediately to the north of Bern railway station. The Lorraine road bridge is adjacent.

spots.name: Christoffelturm

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Christoffelturm was a tower built between the years 1344 and 1346, which featured a prominently displayed statue of Saint Christopher. It was located in the old part of the Swiss city of Bern, in the upper section of Spitalgasse, near Holy Spirit Church.

spots.name: Spitalgasse
spots.summary: The Spitalgasse is one of the streets in the Old City of Bern, the medieval city center of Bern, Switzerland. It is part of the Äussere Neustadt which was built during the third expansion from 1344 to 1346.

spots.name: Holländerturm

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Holländerturm is a former defensive tower in the old city of Bern in Switzerland. It is part of the UNESCO Cultural World Heritage Site of the Old City of Bern. The tower was originally part of the city wall of Bern but was absorbed by the house at Waisenhausplatz 15.

spots.name: Halen
spots.summary: The Halen Estate is a housing development near Berne, Switzerland. It was designed and built by the Atelier 5 architectural partnership from 1957 to 1961.

spots.summary: Excellent soups, a good rendering of Swiss standards, such as cheese fondue, and a decent number of veggie choices. Many items are available in half portions.
